components.css: .ds-focus{font-family:var(--font-sans);letter-spacing:-.015em;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:19px 20px;background:var(--color-surface);color:var(--color-text);border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-line)}.ds-focus:hover{background:#fcfdff}.ds-number{width:24px;flex-shrink:0;font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--color-muted);font-weight:600;align-self:flex-start;line-height:24px}.ds-title{font-family:var(--font-sans);letter-spacing:-.015em;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.5;text-align:left;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:var(--color-text);border:0;background:none;padding:0;cursor:pointer}.ds-title:hover{color:var(--color-primary)}.ds-title:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--color-primary);outline-offset:3px}.ds-next{font-size:12px;color:var(--color-secondary);line-height:1.6;margin:6px 0 0}.ds-meta{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--color-muted);margin-top:9px}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-focus{padding:16px 13px;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start}.ds-title{font-size:14px}.ds-number{width:18px;font-size:11px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-primary,.ds-secondary,.ds-text,.ds-field,.ds-nav,.ds-chip,.ds-title{transition:background var(--duration-fast) ease-out,color var(--duration-fast) ease-out,border-color var(--duration-fast) ease-out}}

narrative.overview:
The quiet work console makes operational reading immediate: a dark navigation rail frames a cool neutral canvas, while white grouped surfaces and fine rules organize dense information. Blue identifies actions and selection; text hierarchy and alignment carry the rest.

The component system uses native interface typography, restrained curves and flat surfaces. Connection and draft labels remain explicit, so a polished presentation never implies an AI adapter is running or a draft has been dispatched.
keyCharacteristics: Dark rail with cool neutral content.
One blue action accent with semantic status colors.
Ranked focus rows and aligned work metadata.
Flat surfaces, visible focus and responsive reflow.

rules.name: The Action Blue Rule
rules.body: Use blue for actions, selection and review emphasis; reserve warning, error and success colors for their stated status.

rules.name: The Flat Work Rule
rules.body: Keep working surfaces flat; reserve shadows for dialogs and transient notifications.

dos: Do keep priority, title, status, assigned AI and deadline easy to scan.
Do preserve explicit draft, sample and disconnected labels.
Do use the existing inline stroke SVGs and visible keyboard focus.
Do reflow rows into stacked metadata and move navigation to the bottom on mobile.
donts: Don't imply running AI, dispatch or external approval through status styling.
Don't add decorative hero treatments, repeated badges or a circular progress display to this console.
Don't add external fonts, imagery or a second decorative action accent.
